newsitem.title: JAPAN: Aisin Seiki plans 10 bln yen European plant - paper.
newsitem.headline: Aisin Seiki plans 10 bln yen European plant - paper.

text.p: Japanese automobile parts maker Aisin Seiki Co Ltd plans to spend about 10 billion yen to build a factory in Europe as early as 2000, business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Tuesday.
The paper said the company expects to supply engine parts and other auto parts to Toyota Motor Corp's second European factory, planned for as early as 2000.
Aisin also hopes to supply European carmakers, it said.
The company plans to shortly dispatch a team to study possible sites for the new plant. The team will visit France and eastern European countries, it said.
A company spokesman was not immediately available to comment on the report.
